final: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.raceId, r.name AS race_name, AVG(cr.points) AS avg_points, COUNT(*) AS result_count FROM constructorResults cr JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cr.raceId WHERE cr.points >= 1.0 GROUP BY r.raceId, r.name), with_name_avg AS (SELECT raceId, race_name, avg_points, result_count, AVG(avg_points) OVER (PARTITION BY race_name) AS name_avg_points FROM per_race) SELECT raceId, race_name, avg_points, result_count, avg_points / name_avg_points AS ratio FROM with_name_avg ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
